integrity_amendment.reason: Bind the canonical registry and post-generation development audit after correcting scanner semantics and enforcing every already-declared gate. The corrected structural scan remains a termination result, not preregistered confirmatory evidence.

research_question: For controlled direct-sink substitutions in pinned AI-generated research workspaces, does a deterministic evidence-path packet improve exact artifact-aware reviewer detection without increasing clean-workspace false alarms?

closest_priors.title: How Far Are We From True Auto-Research?
closest_priors.absorbed_claim: Artifact-aware review reveals fabricated results, underpowered experiments, and plan-execution mismatches in 117 auto-research papers.
closest_priors.residual: It does not isolate result-origin substitutions with paired clean/mutated code or evaluate a source-linked detection aid.

closest_priors.title: SciCoQA: Quality Assurance for Scientific Paper-Code Alignment
closest_priors.absorbed_claim: LLMs struggle to detect semantic conflicts between scientific methods described in papers and implementations in code.
closest_priors.residual: Its task definition excludes general bugs and result-only reproducibility failures; it does not test direct result-sink provenance substitution.

closest_priors.title: scicode-lint: Detecting Methodology Bugs in Scientific Python Code with LLM-Generated Patterns
closest_priors.absorbed_claim: Scientific-code linters can detect semantic methodology bugs using generated detection patterns.
closest_priors.residual: It targets methodology anti-patterns rather than paper-result provenance paths or artifact-review sensitivity to controlled substitutions.

intervention.target: one computed scalar expression that directly supplies a recognized result artifact sink
intervention.replacement: a plausible scalar numeric literal deterministically drawn from the workspace manuscript and matched to the target scalar type
requirements: original and mutated files parse with the same pinned Python grammar
the surrounding call, key, container, and output schema remain unchanged
the replacement contains no marker, comment, sentinel name, or formatting cue
the target and replacement hashes are recorded before reviewer execution
the mutation is confined to one source span

recognized_sink_families: plot data supplied to a saved figure

systems.lexical_sink_scan: Deterministic baseline that warns on literal values at recognized result sinks without interprocedural provenance.
systems.artifact_review: Pinned frontier reviewer with paper and repository context, structured output, and no evidence packet.
systems.evidence_packet_review: The same pinned reviewer and call budget with deterministic source-linked sink and local def-use evidence.

grading.positive_match: Exact relative file plus overlap with the frozen mutation line span plus category literal_evidence_substitution.
grading.clean_false_positive: Any literal_evidence_substitution finding in the paired clean workspace.
grading.invalid_output: Schema-invalid, missing required fields, or path outside the workspace.

estimands.primary: paper-level Youden J = exact mutated recall - clean false-positive rate
estimands.meaningful_improvement: evidence_packet_review exceeds artifact_review by at least 0.15 absolute Youden J, has exact mutated recall at least 0.50, and does not increase clean false-positive rate by more than 0.05

bounded_development.purpose: schema, mutation realism, packet format, and grader debugging only

confirmatory_design.condition_order: deterministic balanced order fixed before calls

bounded_development_to_confirmatory: deterministic grader precision is 1.0 on synthetic unit tests
no condition or mutation marker leaks into reviewer-visible paths
invalid reviewer output rate is at most 0.05
estimated provider cost and wall time remain inside the frozen budget
confirmatory_to_paper: all 40 workspaces complete every paired condition
primary and secondary metrics are reported regardless of direction
manual audit covers every claimed true positive and a frozen sample of negatives
claims remain limited to controlled direct-sink substitutions

disallowed_shortcuts: Treating exploratory code examples as confirmatory evidence
Replacing an ineligible confirmatory workspace after outcomes are observed
Using a visible sentinel, mutation comment, filename, or prompt cue
Using an LLM judge for the primary endpoint
Counting files, sinks, findings, or repeats as independent papers
Claiming natural fabrication prevalence from controlled mutations
Weakening a failed gate or converting a null result into an unrelated paper
claim_ceiling: Detection sensitivity and clean false-alarm behavior for controlled, direct-sink numeric provenance substitutions in 40 pinned ResearchArena CPU workspaces; no natural prevalence, misconduct, general scientific-code, or universal reviewer claim.
